title: Bounded decoding vertex value
statement: Let $q$ be a positive integer and let $G$ be a regular unique game over $q$ symbols. Let the table assign to each vertex a function from the Boolean cube $\\{−1,1\\}^{q}$ to $[-1,1]$. For a real parameter $\\varepsilon$, a default symbol in $\\{0,\\ldots,q-1\\}$, and a vertex $v$, the bounded decoding vertex value is the expectation, over a neighbor of $v$, of the bounded decoding edge value on the edge from $v$ to that neighbor.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with alphabet size $q$
A table of functions on the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube taking values in $[-1,1]$
A default symbol in the alphabet
caveat: The candidate decoding constructions and the neighbor distribution are not defined in the supplied snippet, so the value cannot be fully specified self-containedly.
